lines: Two arm myths that keep your arms small...
and number one is in every gym.
curls are all you need for big arms.
Your triceps are about two-thirds of your upper arm...
so skip them, and you skip most of the size.
hammer curls are just a forearm exercise.
They hit the brachialis under your biceps...
which pushes it up and makes your arm look thicker.
hook:
2 ARM MYTHS THAT
KEEP ARMS SMALL
